user.title: Set up Voice Timers
user.description: Adds named voice timers ("set a washer timer for 50 minutes") with repeating ring announcements. Configure timer slots and other options after setup, from this integration's Configure button.

data_description.timer_slots: How many named timers can run at once.
data_description.override_builtin_timer: When on (default), every timer command goes through this integration — unnamed ones like "set a timer for 10 minutes", plus pause, resume, add/remove time, cancel and status — so Home Assistant's built-in satellite timers are never used. Delayed commands ("turn off the lights in 10 minutes") still use Home Assistant's built-in handling. When off, Home Assistant's built-in timers work as normal alongside named timers from this integration. Named timer commands ("set a washer timer for 10 minutes") always go through this integration either way.
data_description.ring_repeat_seconds: How often the "[name] timer is done" announcement repeats while a finished timer is still ringing.
data_description.ring_max_minutes: Safety cutoff so a forgotten timer doesn't announce forever.
data_description.announce_targets: Which Assist satellites announce finished timers. Leave empty to announce on every satellite.
